Description

Field Descriptions

go - csr.tx.send.go

Any write launches the Tx FSM on the TLP in tx_payload, so it comes LAST, after every entry of the TLP. The FSM takes the length from DW0 (Fmt and Length). External: nothing is stored, the write strobe (req) starts the FSM.
